title: Registry Model Options Schema
description: Generates a model interface (*.model.ts) under src/app/shared/models.

name.description: The name for the new model.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the model?

project.description: The name of the project where the model should be added.

path.description: The path where the model file should be created, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to src/app/shared/models.
